## Block Markup

This is a [**static block**](/docs/getting-started/fundamentals/static-dynamic-rendering.md). The markup is saved directly in the post content.

```html
<!-- wp:quote {"value":""} -->
<!-- Content... -->
<!-- /wp:quote -->
```
